name: OpenProject
description: OpenProject is a web-based project management system for location-independent team collaboration, this is a release of the open-source community edition. Once the container has started it may take a few minutes before the WebUI is available, see container logs for startup progress. The default administrator login credentials are: **Username:** `admin` **Password:** `admin` For advanced configuration, see all supported environment variables: (https://www.openproject.org/docs/installation-and-operations/configuration/environment/#supported-environment-variables)

paths.name: Postgres Data Directory
paths.description: The directory to store all data from the Postgres database running on this container.

paths.name: Assets Directory
paths.description: The directory where assets are saved.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: The port to serve the frontend WebUI.

variables.name: Host Name
variables.description: This must be equal to your server IP and the WebUI port above. (5683 by default)

variables.name: Secret Key Base
variables.description: The secret key used to sign sensitive data, enter a random string here.

variables.name: Application Title
variables.description: Change the default application title that appears on the frontend.

variables.name: Max Attachment Size (KB)
variables.description: The maximum file size (KB) to allow for attachments, defaults to 5 MB. (1024KB = 1MB)

variables.name: HSTS Headers
variables.description: Allow disabling of HSTS headers and HTTP > HTTPS redirects, this should only be enabled if HTTPS is on.

variables.name: Use HTTPS (SSL)
variables.description: Whether or not to use HTTPS, if you only plan to only run OpenProject locally then leave this disabled.
